review/generated.go.patch:
diff --git a/review/generated.go b/review/generated.go
index a72bb51..cd415f3 100644
--- a/review/generated.go
+++ b/review/generated.go
@@ -39,7 +39,7 @@ const (
 )
 
 // generatedMarker is the line that marks a file as generated; its first group is the command.
-var generatedMarker = regexp.MustCompile(`Code generated by (.+?)[.;]? DO NOT EDIT\.`)
+var generatedMarker = regexp.MustCompile(`Code generated by (.+?)[.;]?\s+DO NOT EDIT\.`)
 
 // generatedMarkerLines is how many lines from the top of a file may carry the marker.
 const generatedMarkerLines = 5

wrong.name: keeps the period before DO NOT EDIT
wrong.scenario: A period before DO NOT EDIT is not part of the command
wrong.step: Then review-generated-marker-command-parsing: the command is "go run gen.go" on line 1
